title: c2c-gem5: Full System Simulation of Cache-Coherent Chip-to-Chip Interconnects
problem: High-Performance Computing is shifting toward chiplet-based System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures, but current simulation tools lack comprehensive support for cache-coherent multi-chip systems needed for early design exploration.
motivation: Chiplet architectures are becoming dominant in HPC, requiring simulation tools that can accurately model cache-coherent chip-to-chip interconnects for design and optimization.
method: The authors extended gem5 (a computer chip simulator) with a new model that simulates how separate chips communicate and keep their data consistent within a single system. This model can enforce different data-consistency rules—like Arm's CHI protocol, which ensures that when one chip updates a piece of data, all other chips see that update instead of using stale copies. The authors validated this model by comparing its results to real hardware.
key_novelty: They added the ability to simulate multiple chips with synchronized memory caches using various data-consistency protocols—a capability gem5 previously lacked.
contributions: Extended gem5 simulator with cache-coherent multi-chip support
Adaptable to various coherence protocols (Arm CHI, etc.)
Calibrated with real hardware for accuracy

metrics.other: accuracy in simulating coherent chip-to-chip interactions

primary_theme: Gem5 simulator extension for cache-coherent chiplet interconnects
